Simulation::Particles::get_normalized_ag.summary: This allows one to get an output array of age values for a particle system where at birth the ages are 0.0 going to 1.0 at the particle death. This is useful for things like setting shading properties or handling secondary emission.

Simulation::Particles::get_particle_solv.summary: This is for use when editing a `simulate_particles` compound. It allows one to easily access all the properties on the particle solver object.
Allows access to the individual properties on the particle solver settings object.

Simulation::Particles::get_particles.summary: When editing inside the `simulate_particles` compounds this may be used to access the particles object on the particle solver object.

Simulation::Particles::particle_solver_s.summary: Allows the user to specify global parameters used by the `simulate_particles` compound.

Simulation::Particles::preserve_foam_vol.summary: Allows the user to specify global parameters used by the `simulate_particles` for preserving volume, particularly for foam simulations. These properties allow for efficient self collision and surface tension effects between particles.

Simulation::Particles::property_kill_poi.summary: This allows one to remove points from a point object based on a specified point property along with a threshold. This can be useful in situations where one is emitting particles from one system into another. One could, for example, remove all points below a defined age before passing to the source on a second particle system, so that only older particles emit. Or by using point_velocity with a...

Simulation::Particles::set_orientation_v.summary: This allows one to set a quaternion rotation value from an Euler angle in degrees. This can useful for setting `point_orientation`, for example when using `vary_source_property`.

Simulation::Particles::set_particle_prop.summary: This may be used downstream of a `simulate_particles` compound to set a property based on the normalized particle ages. For example one could set the point_size or color based on the particle age. The values defined for birth and death are interpolated based on the particle age.

Simulation::Particles::set_particles.summary: When editing inside the `simulate_particles` compounds this may be used to set the particles property on the particle solver object.

Simulation::Particles::set_spin_value.summary: This allows one to define a spin rotation vector value based on an input Euler rotation in degrees. This is useful to setting spin for `vary_source_property`.

Simulation::Particles::simulate_particle.summary: This is the main particle system solver compound. It emits particles, ages and kills them,  collides them with objects, and applies fields.

Simulation::Particles::source_foam.summary: Allows the user to emit particles from an input liquid volume to create foam.

Simulation::Particles::source_particle_r.summary: Some additional properties for the particle source that control rotation of particles

Simulation::Particles::source_particles.summary: Allows the user to emit particles into a simulate_particles compound.

Simulation::RigidBodies::Internal::add_r.summary: Create or update the `point_instance_name` geo property which can be used to filter instances with an expression in compounds such as `sample_and_constrain` and `constrain_in_radius`.

Simulation::RigidBodies::Internal::creat.summary: Creates static collider meshes to be plugged into the `static_collider_meshes` port of the `simulate_rigid_bodies` node.

Simulation::RigidBodies::active_state_sw.summary: This allows one to switch between different `active_state` field cases. It is for use in field expressions for rigid body influences. One may use a `property_proxy_field` for `active_state` to get the `active_state` as a scalar field. This can then be passed into `active_state_condition`, which will select which case to use as the result based on the `active_state`. One could also use the outpu...

Simulation::RigidBodies::active_state_to.summary: This converts an `active_state` enum to a scalar field with numeric values representing the enum. This is intended for field expressions used in an influence for rigid bodies.

Simulation::RigidBodies::bake_rigid_body.summary: Bakes all geometries used by the input instances into a single array of collision or render geometries.

Simulation::RigidBodies::basic_rigid_bod.summary: This sets up a simple graph that can create rigid body simulations. To use it, connect meshes or instances to `create_rigid_bodies.geometry` and connect `simulate_rigid_bodies.out_instances` to an output.

This sets up a simple graph that can create rigid body simulations. To use it, connect meshes or instance shapes to `rigid_body_instance.geometry`, connect points to `create_instances.points` and connect `simulate_rigid_bodies.out_instances` to an output.

Simulation::RigidBodies::constrain_in_ra.summary: This node generates constraints of type `constraint_type` by comparing the distance between the points in `points_to_constrain`, called `rigid_body_a`, and the points in `points_to_search` that fall within the `search_radius`, called `rigid_body_b`. The constraints are applied to the `instances`.

Simulation::RigidBodies::constraint_id_m.summary: This node allows one to mask the effect of a constraint influence based on a range of instance ids. The constraints have a rigid_body_id_a and rigid_body_id_b property that determines what is constrained. This node checks if either of those ids are within the min_id to max_id range and then masks the influence to only have an effect if in that range. So if both min_id and max_id were zero then...

Simulation::RigidBodies::constraint_infl.summary: This lets one access some point properties from instances with a constraint modifier influence. These may then be accessed with `property_proxy_field` nodes to use in a constraint modifier. For example if the string array contains "velocity", then the properties "velocity_a" and "velocity_b" can be accessed with a `property_proxy_field` (set to vector_field type). In all cases except for "stren...

Simulation::RigidBodies::constraint_reco.summary: This node allows one to reconnect a broken constraint. Note that in some cases the constrained objects may suddenly snap positions when the constraint is reconnected.

Simulation::RigidBodies::constraint_scop.summary: Visualize the constraints applied to a rigid body simulation.  Constraints will be shown as arrows between their pivots.

Simulation::RigidBodies::constraint_stre.summary: This node allows one to modify the strength of constraints over time, and break constraints based on various properties. For constraints a negative strength like -1 will make it unbreakable. This node should be connected to the `constraint_influences` port of a `simulate_rigid_bodies` node.

Simulation::RigidBodies::construct_const.summary: Plug in the instances created by `create_rigid_body` or `merge_rigid_bodies` to `construct_constraint`.

Simulation::RigidBodies::convex_decompos.summary: Convex decomposition scope is used to display the `convex_decomposition` of an object in the viewport.

Simulation::RigidBodies::create_animated.summary: Create rigid body instances based on an input animated mesh. The mesh will be approximated by rigid bodies so it's best if the selection moves more or less rigidly. The instances created by this node have no render or proxy geometry and so won't be shown in the viewport. The diagnostic port of `simulate_rigid_bodies` can be used to see them.

Simulation::RigidBodies::create_rigid_bo.summary: Creates an instance object consisting of rigid bodies attached to the point positions of the input geometry. Multiple shapes are supported, and can be assigned in various ways.
Creates a rigid box to be plugged into the `collision_geometries` port of the `create_rigid_body_instances` node.

Simulation::RigidBodies::create_rigid_ca.summary: Creates a rigid capsule to be plugged into the `collision_geometries` port of the `create_rigid_body_instances` node. A capsule is a cylinder with spherical caps.

Simulation::RigidBodies::create_rigid_cy.summary: Creates a rigid cylinder to be plugged into the `collision_geometries` port of the `create_rigid_body_instances` node.

Simulation::RigidBodies::create_rigid_sp.summary: Creates a rigid sphere to be plugged into the `collision_geometries` port of the `create_rigid_body_instances` node.

Simulation::RigidBodies::create_static_c.summary: Create rigid body instances based on the input `meshes`. The output can be connected to the `static_collider_instances` port of the `simulate_rigid_bodies` node or to a constrain node. It may also be connected to the `instances` port and will create stationary colliders.

Simulation::RigidBodies::merge_rigid_bod.summary: Merges an array of `rigid_bodies` into a single object. The constraints are merged, and the instance selector is flattened.

Simulation::RigidBodies::rigid_body_inst.summary: Creates a rigid body instance shape. The `rigid_body_instance` can be connected to  the `instance_geometries` port on `set_instance_geometry` or `create_instances`, in order to create instances for `simulate_rigid_bodies`.

Simulation::RigidBodies::sample_and_cons.summary: This node creates constraints of type `constraint_type` between locations on the surface of the instance shapes in `sampled_tag` and the points in `closest_tag` that are within the `cutoff_distance`. The constraints are applied to the `instances`.

Simulation::RigidBodies::set_rigid_prope.summary: Set rigid properties on input instances.

USD::Attribute::add_attribute_connection.summary: Adds a connection from a `source` attribute to the list of connections in the specified `position`.

USD::Attribute::block_attribute.summary: This node blocks a USD attribute on a USD prim. This causes the attribute to resolve as if there were no authored value opinions in weaker layers.

USD::Attribute::clear_attribute.summary: Clears the authored default value and all time samples for an attribute.

USD::Attribute::create_prim_attribute.summary: This node creates a USD attribute on a USD prim.

USD::Attribute::create_primvar.summary: This node creates a USD UsdGeomPrimvar on a USD prim.

USD::Attribute::define_usd_attribute.summary: Defines a USD attribute and, optionally, its value. The output can be connected to the `attribute_definitions` port of `define_usd_prim` and other nodes to set attributes on the corresponding prims.

USD::Attribute::define_usd_display_color.summary: Defines the `primvars:displayColor` attribute. This is a predefined attribute that can be used for previewing. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_attribute`.

USD::Attribute::define_usd_transform.summary: Defines a USD transform attribute. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_attribute`.

USD::Attribute::get_attribute_metadata.summary: This node gets the value of an attribute's metadata.

USD::Attribute::get_prim_attribute.summary: This node returns the attribute with the specified name.

USD::Attribute::get_prim_attribute_conne.summary: This node returns the connections to the attribute.

USD::Attribute::get_prim_attribute_data.summary: This node returns the data of the attribute with the specified name.

USD::Attribute::get_prim_attribute_type.summary: This node returns the attribute with the specified name.

USD::Attribute::get_usd_attribute_value.summary: Returns the value of a USD attribute at a specific frame.

USD::Attribute::remove_attribute_connect.summary: Removes `source` from the list of connections.

USD::Attribute::set_attribute_metadata.summary: This node set the value of an attribute's metadata.

USD::Attribute::set_prim_attribute.summary: This node sets the attribute value with the specified data.

USD::Collection::get_all_collection_name.summary: Returns all collection names of the USD prim.

USD::Collection::get_excludes_paths.summary: Returns the Excludes Targets' paths of the USD collection.

USD::Collection::get_includes_paths.summary: Returns the Includes Targets' paths of the USD collection.

USD::Collection::get_or_create_collectio.summary: Creates or returns a collection on the USD prim.

USD::Layer::add_sublayer.summary: This node adds a sublayer at the end of the sublayers of the given layer. The newly added sublayer becomes the strongest of the sublayers in the Pixar USD root layer.

USD::Layer::create_layer.summary: This creates a new anonymous layer.

USD::Layer::duplicate_layer.summary: This node duplicate the input layer.

USD::Layer::export_layer_to_file.summary: This node writes the composite scene as a flattened USD text representation into the given file.

USD::Layer::export_layer_to_string.summary: This node exports a layer to a string.

USD::Layer::get_layer.summary: This node returns a sublayer from the stage's root layer. The last element in the list of sublayers is the strongest of the sublayers in the Pixar USD root layer.

USD::Layer::get_layer_display_name.summary: This node returns the layer's display name. The display name is the base filename of the identifier.

USD::Layer::get_layer_file_path.summary: This node returns the file path used to save the layer.

USD::Layer::get_layer_identifier.summary: This node returns the layer identifier.

USD::Layer::get_root_layer.summary: This node returns the stage's root layer.

USD::Layer::get_sublayer_paths.summary: This node returns the sublayer paths directly included in the stage. The returned paths are listed from the weakest to the strongest of the sublayers in the USD Layer.

USD::Layer::open_layer.summary: This creates a new anonymous layer from a file on disk.

USD::Layer::open_usd_layer.summary: Opens a USD file as a layer. The `usd` (generic), `usda` (ASCII text), and `usdc` (crate binary) formats are supported for reading and writing, and `usdz` files are supported for reading only.

USD::Layer::replace_layer.summary: This node replaces the sublayer from the stage's root layer at the specified index.

USD::Layer::set_layer_permission.summary: This node changes the layer permission.

USD::PointInstancer::define_usd_point_in.summary: Defines a USD point instancer prim based on a Bifrost points object. This creates instances in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_prim`.

USD::PointInstancer::delete_usd_point_in.summary: Delete point instances from a USD PointInstancer.

USD::PointInstancer::get_usd_point_insta.summary: Returns data used by each instance of a USD PointInstancer.

USD::PointInstancer::replace_usd_point_i.summary: Replace elements in the "protoIndices" attribute of a USD PointInstancer.

USD::PointInstancer::set_usd_point_insta.summary: To hide specific instances of a USD PointInstancer by setting its "invisibleIds" attribute.

USD::PointInstancer::usd_point_instancer.summary: A diagnostic compound for visualizing and analyzing USD PointInstancer as Bifrost points.

USD::Prim::add_applied_schema.summary: Adds the applied API schema to the prim.

USD::Prim::add_inherit_prim.summary: Adds an "inherits" arc to a prim.

USD::Prim::add_payload_prim.summary: Adds a payload arc to a prim.

USD::Prim::add_reference_prim.summary: Adds a prim reference in the given stage.

USD::Prim::add_specialize_prim.summary: Adds a "specializes" arc to a prim.

USD::Prim::clear_relationship_targets.summary: Removes all opinions about the target list from the current edit target.

USD::Prim::compute_usdgeom_extent.summary: This node computes the extent of a boundable prim.

USD::Prim::create_class_prim.summary: Creates a class prim in the given stage.

USD::Prim::create_prim.summary: Creates a prim of the given type (optional) at the given prim path in the given stage.

USD::Prim::create_prim_relationship.summary: Returns a new copy of the stage with a relationship added to a prim.

USD::Prim::create_usd_prim.summary: Adds a USD prim to the current layer of a stage.

USD::Prim::define_usd_curves.summary: Creates a Bifrost-USD curve definition based on strands. This creates a USD `BasisCurves` prim in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_prim`.

USD::Prim::define_usd_geom_subset.summary: Define a USD GeomSubset storing an array of face ids.

USD::Prim::define_usd_mesh.summary: Creates a Bifrost-USD prim definition based on a Bifrost mesh. This creates a mesh in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_prim`.

USD::Prim::define_usd_point_instancer.summary: Defines a USD point instancer prim based on a Bifrost points object. This creates instances in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_prim`.

USD::Prim::define_usd_prim.summary: Creates a Bifrost-USD prim definition. This creates a USD prim in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream.

USD::Prim::define_usd_prim_hierarchy.summary: Creates a hierarchy of Bifrost-USD prim definitions. This creates the USD prim hierarchy in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream.

USD::Prim::define_usd_reference.summary: Defines a USD reference. You can connect the output into the `reference_definitions` port of `define_usd_prim` and similar nodes.

USD::Prim::define_usd_reference_from_fil.summary: Defines a USD reference from a file. You can connect the output into the `reference_definitions` port of `define_usd_prim` and similar nodes.

USD::Prim::define_usd_relationship.summary: Defines a USD relationship. You can connect the output into the `relationship_definitions` port of `define_usd_prim` and similar nodes.

USD::Prim::define_usd_skeleton.summary: Creates a Bifrost-USD prim definition based on a Bifrost skeleton. This creates a USD Skel prim in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_prim`.

USD::Prim::define_usd_skeleton_animation.summary: Creates a Bifrost-USD prim definition based on a Bifrost skeleton. This creates a USD SkelAnimation prim in a stage when you connect the output into an `add_to_stage` node downstream. This node is a specialized compound based on `define_usd_prim`.

USD::Prim::duplicate_usd_prim_definition.summary: Creates copies of Bifrost-USD prim definitions based on a source prim definition.

USD::Prim::get_all_attribute_names.summary: Returns a list of all attribute names in a USD prim.

USD::Prim::get_applied_schemas.summary: Get the names of API schemas which have been applied to this prim.

USD::Prim::get_authored_attribute_names.summary: Returns a list of authored attribute names in a USD prim.

USD::Prim::get_forwarded_relationship_ta.summary: Composes this relationship's ultimate targets, taking into account "relationship forwarding" and returns the list.

USD::Prim::get_last_modified_prim.summary: Returns the last USD prim authored in the stage.

USD::Prim::get_prim_asset_info.summary: Returns the asset identifier, name, and version.

USD::Prim::get_prim_at_path.summary: Returns the USD prim at the specified path in the stage.

USD::Prim::get_prim_children.summary: Returns the array of children of a prim.

USD::Prim::get_prim_in_prototype.summary: Returns the prim path of the corresponding prim in the instance's prototype if this prim is an instance proxy.

USD::Prim::get_prim_instances.summary: Returns all prims that are instances of this prototype, if this prim is a prototype prim.

USD::Prim::get_prim_kind.summary: Get the kind for the specified prim.

USD::Prim::get_prim_metadata.summary: Gets the value of a prim's metadata.

USD::Prim::get_prim_path.summary: Returns the path of a USD prim.

USD::Prim::get_prim_type.summary: Returns the type name of a USD prim.

USD::Prim::get_prototype_prims.summary: Returns all prototype prims in this stage.

USD::Prim::get_relationship_targets.summary: Composes this relationship's targets and returns the list.

USD::Prim::get_usd_geom_points.summary: This node outputs the points data of a point-based USD prim at the requested frame.

USD::Prim::get_usd_geom_xform_vectors.summary: This node returns the translation, rotation, scale, pivot and rotation order of a prim.

USD::Prim::override_prim.summary: Returns a new copy of the stage with an override prim added.

USD::Prim::prim_clear_instanceable.summary: Removes the authored "instanceable" opinion for this prim.

USD::Prim::prim_get_prototype.summary: Returns the prim path to to the corresponding prototype if this prim is an instance, or an empty path otherwise.

USD::Prim::prim_has_authored_instanceabl.summary: Returns true if this prim has an authored opinion for "instanceable", false otherwise.

USD::Prim::prim_is_in_prototype.summary: Returns true if the specified prim is located in a subtree of prims rooted at a prototype prim, false otherwise.

USD::Prim::prim_is_instance.summary: Returns true if the specified prim is an instance of a prototype, false otherwise.

USD::Prim::prim_is_instance_proxy.summary: Returns true if the specified prim is an instance proxy, false otherwise.

USD::Prim::prim_is_instanceable.summary: Returns whether this prim has been marked as instanceable.

USD::Prim::prim_is_prototype.summary: Returns true if the specified prim is a prototype prim, false otherwise.

USD::Prim::remove_applied_schema.summary: Removes the applied API schema from the prim.

USD::Prim::remove_payload_prim.summary: Removes the given prim payload from the given stage.

USD::Prim::remove_reference_prim.summary: Removes the given prim reference from the given stage.

USD::Prim::rotate_prim.summary: This node rotates a USD prim.

USD::Prim::scale_prim.summary: This node scales a USD prim.

USD::Prim::set_prim_active.summary: Authors "active" metadata for this prim at the current EditTarget.

USD::Prim::set_prim_asset_info.summary: Sets the model's info dictionary for the specified prim.

USD::Prim::set_prim_kind.summary: Authors a kind for the specified prim.

USD::Prim::set_prim_metadata.summary: Sets the value of a prim's metadata.

USD::Prim::set_prim_pivot.summary: This node sets the prim pivot.

USD::Prim::set_prim_purpose.summary: Authors a purpose for the specified prim.

USD::Prim::set_relationship_targets.summary: Sets the target list explicitly to the list provided. Note that this fails if any of the targets are invalid.

USD::Prim::translate_prim.summary: This node translates a USD prim.

USD::Prim::usd_point_instancer.summary: This node creates a point instancer.

USD::Prim::usd_volume.summary: This node creates a USD volume prim.

USD::Shading::bind_material.summary: Binds a material to a prim directly, or to a collection on the prim. The `collection_name` must be specified to bind to a collection. `binding_name` can stay empty.

USD::Shading::define_usd_preview_surface.summary: This compound demonstrates one possible way to create a material in Bifrost-USD. It creates a prim that defines a basic material with a `UsdPreviewSurface` shader.

USD::Shading::get_material_path.summary: Returns the material path of a USD prim.

USD::Shading::unbind_material.summary: Unbinds a direct or collection-based binding. The `binding_name` must be specified to unbind a collection.

USD::Stage::add_to_stage.summary: Adds one or more Bifrost-USD prim definitions to a new or existing USD stage. This creates USD prims on the stage.

USD::Stage::export_stage_to_file.summary: This node writes the composite scene as a flattened USD text representation into the given file.

USD::Stage::export_stage_to_string.summary: This node returns the composite scene as a flattened USD text representation as a string.

USD::Stage::get_default_prim.summary: This node gets the stage's default prim.

USD::Stage::get_edit_layer.summary: This node gets the layer targeted by the stage.

USD::Stage::get_stage_metadata.summary: This node gets the value of a stage metadatum if the stage's current UsdEditTarget is the root or session layer.

USD::Stage::open_stage_from_cache.summary: Opens from the cache the stage that is associated to the given ID.

USD::Stage::open_stage_from_layer.summary: Opens a stage from a given layer.

USD::Stage::open_usd_stage.summary: Opens a USD file as a stage. The `usd` (generic), `usda` (ASCII text), and `usdc` (crate binary) formats are supported for reading and writing, and `usdz` files are supported for reading only.

USD::Stage::save_stage.summary: This node writes the composite scene as a flattened USD text representation.

USD::Stage::save_usd_stage.summary: Saves all modified layers in a Bifrost USD stage to files on disk. The `usd` (generic), `usda` (ASCII text), and `usdc` (crate binary) formats are supported.

USD::Stage::send_stage_to_cache.summary: This sends the stage to the cache and returns its associated ID.

USD::Stage::set_default_prim.summary: This node sets the stage's default prim.

USD::Stage::set_edit_layer.summary: This node sets the stage's EditTarget to the specified layer.

USD::Stage::set_stage_metadata.summary: This node sets the value of a stage metadatum if the stage's current UsdEditTarget is the root or session layer.

USD::Stage::set_stage_time_code.summary: This node writes USD time code data into the root layer.

USD::Stage::set_stage_up_axis.summary: This node sets the stage's up-axis.

USD::VariantSet::add_variant.summary: This node adds a new variant to the variant set on the given stage.

USD::VariantSet::add_variant_set.summary: This node adds a new variant set for the USD prim on the given stage.

USD::VariantSet::clear_variant_selection.summary: This node clear the variant set selection.

USD::VariantSet::define_usd_variant_set.summary: Defines a USD variant set. Connect the output into the `variant_set_definitions` port of `define_usd_prim` or a similar node. For each variant, you can create another prim definition with the corresponding `variant_set_name` and its specific `variant name`, and then connect that into the `children` port of the same `define_usd_prim` or a similar node.

USD::VariantSet::get_variant_sets.summary: This node returns the names of all the variant sets present on a prim.

USD::VariantSet::get_variants.summary: This node returns the names of all the variants present in a variant set.

USD::VariantSet::set_variant_selection.summary: This node selects a given variant on the given variant set of the given stage.
